question: How does dengue spread?
message: Dengue is a viral infection transmitted to humans through the bite of infected mosquitoes [1]. While the primary mode of transmission involves mosquito vectors, there is evidence of the possibility of maternal transmission from a pregnant mother to her baby [4]. Rare cases of transmission via blood products, organ donation, and transfusions have also been recorded [4].

question: What are the symptoms of malaria?
message: The most common early symptoms of malaria are fever, headache and chills [1], [2], [3]. Severe symptoms include extreme tiredness and fatigue, impaired consciousness, multiple convulsions, difficulty breathing, dark or bloody urine, jaundice (yellowing of the eyes and skin), and abnormal bleeding [2], [3].

question: What is hypertension?
message: Hypertension (high blood pressure) is when the pressure in your blood vessels is too high (140/90 mmHg or higher) [3]. It is diagnosed if, when measured on two different days, the systolic blood pressure readings on both days are ≥140 mmHg and/or the diastolic blood pressure readings on both days are ≥90 mmHg [5].

question: How can I prevent snake bites?
message: Prevention of snake bites involves informing communities about snake bite risks and prevention techniques including wearing protective shoes/boots, keeping storage areas clear of rodents, raising beds above floor level, and tucking mosquito nets securely under sleeping mats [1].

question: What should I do after a dog bite?
message:
The main principles of care include early medical management, irrigation and cleansing of the wound with soap and running water for 15 minutes, primary closure if the wound is low risk for developing infection, prophylactic antibiotics for high-risk wounds or people with immune deficiency, rabies post-exposure treatment depending on the dog vaccination status, and administration of a tetanus vaccine if the person has not been adequately vaccinated [1]. It is also recommended to confine the dog and observe it daily for 10 days under the supervision of a veterinarian and in coordination with local public health authorities [1].

question: डेंगू के लक्षण क्या होते हैं?
message: डेंगू के सबसे सामान्य लक्षणों में तेज बुखार, सिरदर्द, बदन दर्द, मतली और रैश (चकत्ते) शामिल हैं [1], [2]। इसके अतिरिक्त, लक्षणों में आंखों के पीछे दर्द, मांसपेशियों और जोड़ों में दर्द, उल्टी और ग्रंथियों में सूजन भी शामिल हो सकती है [1]। गंभीर डेंगू के लक्षणों में गंभीर पेट दर्द, लगातार उल्टी, तेजी से सांस लेना, मसूड़ों या नाक से खून आना, थकान, बेचैनी, उल्टी या मल में खून आना, बहुत अधिक प्यास लगना, त्वचा का पीला और ठंडा पड़ना, और कमजोरी महसूस होना शामिल हैं [1], [5]।

question: dengue ke symptoms kya hain
message: Dengue ke sabse aam lakshan high fever, headache, body aches, nausea aur rash hain [1], [2]. Kuch logon mein severe dengue ke lakshan bhi ho sakte hain, jaise ki severe abdominal pain, lagatar vomiting, tez saans lena, masudon ya naak se khoon aana, thakan, bechaini, ulti ya stool mein khoon aana, bahut pyaas lagna, aur twacha ka peela ya thanda padna [1].

question: डेंग्यू कसा पसरतो?
message: डेंग्यू हा विषाणूजन्य संसर्ग आहे जो संक्रमित डासांच्या चावण्याद्वारे मानवांमध्ये पसरतो [1]. मानवांमध्ये डेंग्यूचा प्रसार होण्याचे प्राथमिक माध्यम डास हे आहेत [3], [4]. डास अशा व्यक्तींकडून संक्रमित होऊ शकतात ज्यांच्या रक्तामध्ये डेंग्यू विषाणू (viremic) आहे, मग ती व्यक्ती लक्षणे असलेली असो, लक्षणे येण्यापूर्वीची (pre-symptomatic) असो किंवा कोणतीही लक्षणे नसलेली (asymptomatic) असो [4]. याव्यतिरिक्त, गरोदर मातेकडून बाळाला (मॅटर्नल ट्रान्समिशन) डेंग्यू होणे शक्य असल्याचे पुरावे आहेत [3], [4]. दुर्मिळ प्रकरणांमध्ये, रक्त उत्पादने, अवयव दान आणि रक्तसंक्रमणाद्वारे देखील डेंग्यूचा प्रसार झाल्याची नोंद आहे [3].
